name: Do You Fitness
summary:
Do You Fitness is a new type of fitness game where scored exercises and drive the outcome of dramatic situations.  Exercise reps propel various scenes where you may: aid an alchemist during a resurrection, survive a standoff with police, negotiate with a crime boss, resist the probing of an alien, find oneness in the desert, seek decontamination in the wasteland, and more.
